Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?Then this might be your new challenge!You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the correct location.- You work with an electric pallet truck.- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.
- Vaardigheden:You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.You enjoy active work.You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.- Attesten:Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.- Opleidingsvereisten:No diploma required.- Talenkennis:Good knowledge of English

In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.
• Act quickly when technical or operational issues occur.
• Look for practical ways to improve efficiency on the production floor.
• Maintain clear communication with production planning and finished goods storage.
• Keep the Production Manager informed about progress and possible challenges.
• Help introduce and optimize the use of MES and ERP systems within the department.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.
• You are confident when guiding colleagues and making decisions on the work floor.
• A practical mindset and a flexible attitude come naturally to you.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.
• You are comfortable using computer systems and willing to learn new software.
• Working in two shifts fits your availability.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Our client is a renowned company specializing in the production of high-quality frozen potato products. With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we pride ourselves on delivering premium products to customers across Europe and beyond.

 
• 
Starting up, operating, and adjusting production machines.

 
• 
Monitoring the production process to ensure smooth and efficient operations.

 
• 
Identifying and resolving minor technical malfunctions or contacting the technical team when necessary.

 
• 
Following production schedules and meeting productivity targets.

 
• 
Performing quality checks to maintain high product standards.

 
• 
Ensuring clear communication and effective teamwork.

 
• 
Supporting daily operations on the production floor.

 
• 
Following safety, hygiene, and food quality regulations.

 
• 
Previous experience in production or a similar environment.

 
• 
Basic technical knowledge and an interest in working with machinery.

 
• 
Ability to work independently and take responsibility.

 
• 
Proactive, reliable, and solution-oriented attitude.

 
• 
Good command of English.

 
• 
Availability to work in a 2-shift system.

 
• 
Strong team spirit and a hands-on mentality.

 
• 
Forklift experience or certification is considered an advantage.

Are you accurate, well organised and interested in developing your career in accounting? Join NHV’s Finance team as an Accounting Assistant and help ensure that our accounting and administrative processes are completed accurately and on time.

In this role, you will support our accountants with day-to-day administrative activities and invoice processing. Your main responsibilities will include:

• 
Processing incoming invoices and credit notes in accordance with internal procedures

• 
Managing invoice approval workflows

• 
Monitoring outstanding vendor items

• 
Processing bank transactions

• 
Preparing payment proposals

• 
Communicating by telephone and email with suppliers worldwide regarding administrative matters

• 
Handling company and financial information responsibly and following all applicable Information Security Management System policies and procedures

We are looking for an enthusiastic and reliable colleague who works accurately, takes initiative and enjoys contributing to a team.

You bring:

• 
A degree in accounting, such as a bachelor’s, graduate or HBO5 qualification, or an equivalent level gained through relevant professional experience

• 
A good level of English and Dutch, both written and spoken

• 
Strong computer skills and an interest in learning new software applications

• 
A hands-on and proactive approach

• 
The ability to plan your work, meet deadlines and manage priorities

• 
Strong attention to detail and an analytical mindset

• 
Good communication skills and a professional approach towards internal colleagues and external suppliers

• 
Flexibility, reliability and a strong sense of teamwork

Knowledge of VAT legislation is considered an advantage. Previous experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and Rydoo is also an asset.

For a meat processing company in Zele, we are looking for motivated Production Workers to join their team.Are you physically strong and enjoy working in a dynamic environment? Then this job is definitely for you! Responsibilities

 
• 
Responsible for unloading trucks

 
• 
Placing pork on the production line and ensuring smooth workflow

 
• 
Trimming meat where needed to get products in the correct shape

 
• 
Alternating between all the above tasks – no day is the same

A physical, varied job in a production environment appeals to you

 
• 
Early mornings are not a problem for you

 
• 
You are a team player and contribute to efficient production

 
• 
You are flexible and willing to work until the job is done

 
• 
Experience in production or logistics

 
• 
Experience in the food sector is a plus

 
• 
Comfortable working in a cooled environment of 7°C

 
• 
Fluent in English and/or Dutch and/or Romanian

 
• 
You have your own transport

We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).You'll work in a 2 shift system.One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)

As a System Engineer, you will be responsible for the operation, administration, maintenance and support of complex infrastructure environments. You will play a key role in ensuring the availability, security and performance of critical systems while adhering to strict security and operational procedures.
Key responsibilities

• Operate, administer and maintain highly available physical, virtual, Storage and networking infrastructure.

• Support backup, restore and disaster recovery activities.

• Perform operating system and infrastructure patching.

• Diagnose and resolve infrastructure incidents.

• Review and implement approved infrastructure changes and upgrades.

• Maintain documentation, procedures and technical runbooks.

• Contribute to audits, reporting activities and compliance requirements.

• Ensure compliance with security procedures, privileged access controls and segregation of duties principles.

What we are looking for

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills

• Ability to work under pressure in critical environments

• Excellent team collaboration capabilities (internal and customer facing)

• Clear communication non-technical stakeholders

• Attention to detail and security-minded approach

Interested?

If you are a System Engineer with an active NATO clearance and experience managing secure enterprise infrastructures, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and join WESTPOLE in supporting critical and highly secure IT environments.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in IT Infrastructure or System Engineering

• Strong expertise in enterprise infrastructure environments like:

• 

• Windows Server and Linux Server administration

• VMware vSphere / ESXi

• TCP/IP networking, VLANs, DNS, routing and Firewall concepts

• Active Directory and Group Policy

• Backup and recovery solutions

• Patch management and system hardening

• SAN Storage technologies, RAID and capacity management

• Infrastructure monitoring and management tools

• Anti-virus and Anti-Malware platforms and EDR forensic solutions

• Professional level English (C1/C2)

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

 

Nice to have:

• PowerShell scripting or infrastructure automation

• Vulnerability management and remediation processes

• Log management platforms

• ITIL-based incident, problem and change management practices

Mandatory Security requirement

⚠️ This position requires an active Top Secret NATO security clearance. Applications without a valid and active clearance cannot be considered.

Passionate about recruitment, market insights and data-driven decision-making? Would you enjoy helping professionals take the next step in their careers through our MBA programmes? Let's meet!MBA RECRUITMENT ADVISOR  (Recruitment & Data Specialist)
 

Vlerick Business School is an innovative, top-ranked and sustainable international business school in the heart of Europe. Our purpose is to 
transform people for a better world! We want being at Vlerick to be a transformative experience where you discover the knowledge, mindset and confidence you need to take your next leap – and become the entrepreneurial leader our world needs.
 

As part of our close-knit team, you’ll bring our strategy and purpose to life. Are you excited to join our 
MBA team as an 
MBA Recruitment Advisor? Here’s what you need to know! 
  
 

Your mission  
 

MBA recruitment (60%)
 
 

• Build relationships with prospective MBA candidates. 

• Guide candidates through the recruitment journey. 

• Generate, nurture and qualify leads. 

• Support admissions and recruitment events. 

• Identify opportunities for more targeted outreach and business development. 

• Work closely with Marketing to improve pipeline generation and conversion.  

Market and employer insights (20%)
 
 

• Engage with employers, recruiters and alumni. 

• Track graduate career outcomes and labour market trends. 

• Identify employer needs and emerging talent demands. 

• Translate market insights into stronger recruitment strategies and candidate value propositions. 

• Support career initiatives and networking events.  

Process and interpret data (20%)
 
 

• Analyse CRM and recruitment funnel data. 

• Build dashboards and reports. 

• Identify bottlenecks and opportunities. 

• Support forecasting and performance tracking. 

• Leverage AI and digital tools to improve insight generation and efficiency. 

You
 
 

• Have hands-on experience 
analysing CRM or 
funnel data and building reports or dashboards (eg in Excel, Power BI or Tableau) that lead to 
concrete recommendations. 

• Use 
GenAI tools in a practical and responsible way for analysis, reporting and content. 

• Are able to hold credible 
advisory conversations with experienced professionals in an international environment and guide them towards a decision. 

• Can turn data into clear stories for prospects, employers and internal stakeholders. 

• Communicate fluently in 
English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is an advantage. 

• Are organised, proactive and comfortable working towards 
conversion targets. 

• Ideally bring experience in recruitment, admissions, sales, business development, consulting or customer success. 

• Experience setting up or managing a CRM or marketing automation platform is a plus. 

• Knowledge of the business school market or graduate labour markets is a plus.  

Take the leap!
 

If you think you meet these criteria, please apply with your resume and motivation letter on our website. Happy to give you more information on the job content: mariaana.pedronunes@vlerick.com and/or the selection process and working at Vlerick: charlotte.mahieu@vlerick.com.

jobs.occupation: Senior Brand Manager LU / PRINCE (Business & Portfolio) BNL
jobs.description:
The Senior Brand Manager is responsible for: market share growth, net revenue and margin performance, brand equity metrics, successful innovation rate, and distribution and in-store execution quality.
 

What Extra Ingredients You Will Bring
 
 

• Strategic Thinking & Execution — Solid strategic thinking with strong execution skills: able to move seamlessly from business analysis to defining what to do with it, identifying the key actions, and translating data into clear next steps. 

• Communication & Influence — Able to structure recommendations so that stakeholders quickly understand the context, the rationale, and the step needed — whether a decision or a request for support. 

• Rigour & Attention to Detail — A natural reflex to cross-check key numbers, spot inconsistencies across documents, and ensure overall accuracy before sharing. 

• Consumer-Centric Mindset — Deep understanding of consumer needs; uses insight to shape brand direction and portfolio decisions. 

• Brand Building & Creativity — Passion for brand building with strong creative judgement and storytelling ability. 

• Financial Acumen — Data-driven decision-making through strong analytical skills and solid P&L management expertise. 

• People Leadership — Strong people management skills; experience developing talent and working in a matrix organisation. 

• Growth Mindset — Autonomy, resilience, and ability to stay current with new developments including AI, digital commerce, and emerging marketing trends.  

Education, Certifications & Requirements
 
 

• Education: Master's degree, preferably in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• Experience: Minimum 7 years of FMCG brand marketing experience, with proven expertise in brand building, portfolio strategy, and new product development. 

• Brand & Portfolio: Proven track record in brand and portfolio strategy, pricing, and innovation development; experience defining brand growth models and translating long-term strategy into concrete short-term interventions. 

• Market Knowledge: Local Benelux market knowledge and experience preferred; experience managing localised brands with high autonomy preferred. 

• Languages: Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.  

What We Offer
 

At Mondelēz International, you will join a company that genuinely believes snacking can make life a little sweeter — for our consumers, our teams, and the world. We offer:
 
 

• A dynamic, international work environment with iconic global brands 

• Real ownership and accountability from day one 

• A collaborative, people-first culture that celebrates curiosity and learning 

• Competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including company car 

• Opportunities for regional and global career growth within Mondelēz 

• Flexible working arrangements and a focus on wellbeing

Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or the perfectly cooked roast beef: dishes that make your mouth water. In this role, you help make sure others can enjoy them too. In our kitchen, we produce preparations that would make grandmothers jealous, but on an industrial scale and in large quantities.

We are looking for a Cook in the Aalter region! 
What are your responsibilities? 
• Hygiene is essential for any kitchen employee. That is why you ensure every day that your working methods and finished products comply with all applicable standards.
• You strictly follow all safety regulations. You do everything possible to guarantee both quality and safety. 

Who are you?
• You have experience as a cook in a large-scale catering kitchen or an industrial kitchen. Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system. 
• The early shift starts at 4:30 AM and ends at 12:30 PM.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 PM and ends at 8:00 PM. 
• Team player – You are friendly, enthusiastic, and enjoy working with others. Helping colleagues comes naturally to you.
• Hands-on – You are proactive, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and have strong practical insight.
• Flexible – You like working as part of a team but can also work independently. In addition, you enjoy the variety of working with different products and tasks.
• Communicative – You have good communication skills and a good command of Dutch and/or English.
